A [[Human/Legends|Human]] was a '''senator''' in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] was still serving on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic&mdash;<ref name="EIIG" />in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. That year,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was removed from office following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the remote planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Senator was had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], light skin and rosy cheeks. They wrapped themselves in a heavy sheet of [[Color/Legends|mauve]] fabric ornated with square motifs and [[Gold/Legends|golden]] lining, under which they wore an ankle-legth white [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]].<ref name="EIIG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The draped Senator was to appear as a background character in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], in which they were portrayed by an unidentified extra. They were a member of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] delegation<ref name="TPM cut">{{Film|I}}, deleted scene featured on the Blu-ray edition.</ref> led by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], who was then played by [[Adrian Dunbar]]. However, the footage including the draped Human was left in the cutting room floor. Dunbar's appearance was later reused as the likeness of [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]],<ref name="dbOrg">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> and two pictures of<ref name="EIIG" /> his<ref name="db">{{DB|character|bailantilles|Antilles, Bail}}</ref> draped colleague appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', an interactive CD-ROM released in [[June]] [[1999]]. Those promotional pictures were part of the "Behind the Scenes" section of the entry on galactic senators, and were captioned as "A human senator in full regalia."<ref name="EIIG" />
